summary: 38 units reviewed; 23 need changes. 6 errors, 34 minor issues; no regrouping suggested. Main findings: Hindi 'राक्षस' for rakṣas (units 7, 24) against GLOSSARY; 'भयरहित' reverses the sense of aghora (12, 17); unit 5 Hindi adds 'हमारे पास' and merges two vocatives; unit 16 Hindi turns 'strike' into 'loosen'; augmented aorists (adāt, agan, āgan) mislabelled injunctive (2, 4, 5, 13, 14, 36); small possessive/word additions in 7, 28, 35, 36. Units 16, 37 (low) and 10, 20 are genuinely uncertain and should stay marked so; unit 10's 'janān anu' construction needs a human look. Marriage-hymn wording (14, 31, 32, 38) is literal and neutral, no change needed. Glossary additions proposed: rakṣas Hindi = रक्षस् (not राक्षस); brahman Hindi = ब्रह्म in all units; aghora = 'not terrible' / अघोर (not भयरहित); Aśvins Hindi = अश्विनौ (voc. अश्विनो); gṛha is masculine; augmented a-aorists are labelled 'aor. (augmented)', injunctive only without augment. All layers remain unreviewed AI drafts.
